title: Bar re-value, then the ratio span

aliases.name: R28 Bar re-value, then the ratio span

members.role: today's number is written at the bar's top first - the compare re-values the figure the page already wrote (E50)
the two-key path (`from`, sourced): the bar shrinks to its old value, holds, and grows back to today, the figure counting at its top
once today has landed, a bracket from the re-valued bar to its neighbour, the multiple written as its label (T50 on bars)

does: Then and now on one bar - it drops to its sourced old value, holds, and grows back to today with the number at its top counting the height - then a bracket to its neighbour says how today compares.

use_when.act: COMPARES - the same data, then -> now on one bar, then -> a ratio (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R28)
use_when.shape: before-after -> ratio: one bar's sourced old value and today's, and a neighbour on the same scale
use_when.use: then-and-now on one bar, then how 'now' compares with its neighbour (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN.md:1089; D40 11:22-12:06, $47B in 2016 -> $94B, then '4x' to the 30-year)
use_when.dont: the old value is unsourced (the guide's don't); the levels would carry labels (E53 addendum - the figures stand at the bar tops, C14); the neighbour is on another scale

source: P71 T24 (harvest v2 R28 on A48): D40 (u70oUWgVoYU) 11:22-12:06 read off the video on disk, the re-value measured at 30 fps; the re-value is pinned by the golden bar-revalue-then-now, and the whole recipe proved as a private test-bed beat by projects/_proofs/p71-recipes/proof_t24.py (r28: H row 16's issuance, 2025 actual beside the 2026E bar, the bracket '+24%' computed 150/121) - no approved cut carries it
